mechanism: Divides the image into 16x16 patches and processes them through a Vision Transformer encoder with multi-head self-attention. The attention mechanism captures long-range dependencies and global patterns across the entire image. The [CLS] token output feeds into a classification head for real/AI determination.
name: Vision Transformer (ViT) Detection
description: Uses Vision Transformer architecture to capture long-range dependencies in images. ViT excels at detecting subtle global patterns that CNNs may miss in AI-generated content.

references.title: Dosovitskiy, A. et al. (2021). An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale. ICLR.
Cocchi, F. et al. (2023). Unveiling the Impact of Image Transformations on Deepfake Detection. Image and Vision Computing.

strengths:
• Captures global image context through self-attention
• Excellent cross-generator generalization
• Attention maps provide interpretability
• Scales well with larger datasets
limitations:
• Requires significant computational resources
• Large model size and memory footprint
• Needs large training datasets for optimal performance
• Patch-based approach may miss sub-patch artifacts
